name: hcapp_getEventMessages2
description: Returns all messages for a specific event with a flat author representation (authorId column), replacing the nested JSON author object in hcapp_getEventMessages. Token validated against DeviceSecret + eventId. UUIDs returned as uppercase — inconsistent with HC6 convention of lowercase UUIDs.

rowsets.name: ErrorRowsets
rowsets.description: Same error pattern as hcapp_getEventMessages — multiple error rowsets possible without RETURN. See that contract for column details.

rowsets.name: Messages
rowsets.description: All messages for the event, ordered by createdAt DESC.

columns.name: authorId
columns.description: UPPER(Hasher.PublicHasherId) — uppercase UUID string. Different from hcapp_getEventMessages which embeds a JSON author object.

codeSmells.issue: UUIDs returned as UPPER() — violates HC UUID convention
codeSmells.detail: Both id and authorId are wrapped in UPPER(). HC6 normalises all UUIDs to lowercase. The Flutter app's @UuidConverter will lowercase on parse, but this is an unnecessary friction point.

codeSmells.issue: Multiple error paths emit rowsets without RETURN — same issue as getEventMessages
codeSmells.detail: deviceId and eventId null checks emit SELECT without RETURN.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
